queries_run: STRL Sterling Infrastructure analyst consensus vs guidance 2026
STRL Sterling Infrastructure guidance raise OR cut 2026

findings.claim: 2026-08-03 Q2 發布時，公司 FY2026 EPS guidance 19.70–20.30 高於事前共識 18.81；營收 guidance $4.0–4.2B 對共識約 $4.0B（約持平）
findings.source: MarketBeat: Sterling Infrastructure releases FY 2026 earnings guidance
findings.excerpt: The company provided EPS guidance of 19.700-20.300 for the period, compared to the consensus EPS estimate of 18.810. The company issued revenue guidance of $4.0 billion-$4.2 billion, compared to the consensus revenue estimate of $4.0 billion.

findings.claim: MarketBeat 彙整共識評級 Buy、平均目標價約 $720.67；分析師 FY2026 EPS 平均約 18.24，低於新 guidance 區間（目標價日期未標，為聚合站數字）
findings.excerpt: analysts anticipate that Sterling Infrastructure will post 18.24 earnings per share for the current fiscal year

findings.claim: 目標價分布隨來源分歧：Bullstory（2026-08-22）6 位分析師均值約 $905、高 $1,000、低 $754；Walnut Invest（2026-08）均值約 $947；Tickflow（2026-08-01）5 位均值約 $656；Fintel（2026-05-14）均值約 $758、範圍 $485–1,050
findings.source: Bullstory / Walnut Invest / Tickflow / Nasdaq-Fintel 聚合

findings.claim: 2026 年兩度上修：Q1（5月）營收 guidance 由 $3.05–3.20B 升至 $3.70–3.80B；Q2（8月）調整後 EPS 由 18.40–19.05 升至 19.70–20.30；無下修紀錄。8月公告後股價曾單日跌約 9.45%，Weiss 歸因為 guidance 隱含的利潤率路徑與營收增速不符
findings.source: Benzinga/Reuters via search summary; Weiss Ratings

findings.claim: Seeking Alpha 2026-04 快照：EPS 近三個月 3 次上修、0 次下修；次一財報預計 2026-11-04 盤後

capital_markets_pricing.note: 各聚合站目標價 as-of 與樣本數不一致（5–8 位分析師），未取得單一權威共識；現價請引 numbers.price_at_dd。多數 finding 僅搜尋摘要，無逐字原文。
